newsitem.title: LEBANON: Pro-Israeli militiaman killed in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Israeli militiaman killed in south Lebanon.

text.p: An Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiaman was killed on Sunday when guerrillas set off a road side bomb near his patrol in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
They said the blast occurred as the SLA militiamen walked towards the outpost of Sojoud in the eastern sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed responsibility for the attack.
In retaliation, Israeli and SLA artillery gunners shelled the southern areas facing Sojoud.
